turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit down properly, today we will do subtraction. Our first sum is fifty two minus twenty seven. Everybody write it in your notebook.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote thirty five? No, no, that is wrong. Seven minus two is not allowed like that. Next, Arjoon, you tell.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: The answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. All of you say it with me: twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjun, again I am telling. You borrow one ten, so two becomes twelve. Twelve minus seven is five. Then four minus two is two. Borrow, then twelve minus seven. Listen carefully this time!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Who has got twenty five? Thumbs up if you got twenty five.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Okay, next sum. Forty three minus eighteen. Do it quickly, everyone.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, why are you counting on fingers? Don't use fingers in class two, it takes too long. And your answer is wrong only. Put your hands down.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: The answer is twenty five. Forty three minus eighteen is twenty five. Write it down and copy it from the board, everybody.
turns.label: tell_answer
